notes:
- Project Xfer > Send: Clear now starts a new package. If you'd loaded an earlier version to look at, it's let go (Version goes back to New version) and the Package list is empty. Nothing on disk is deleted.
- Project Xfer > Send, less cramped: Latest / Modify / Clear on their own row under Package; Package Name and Version labels sit above their boxes; Open Folder (was Show in Explorer) next to the Saves to line; shorter dates (Oct 08  14:32); bigger minimum window size.
- Buttons are now just Package and Close. Package clears everything for the next one; Close when you're done.
- Project Xfer > Receive: the tick boxes now have their own column on the left (like Send), always visible. Click its header to tick / untick everything.
- Project Xfer: the big twirl-down triangles are replaced with + / - like Open / Save As (Send's list on the left, the Package list, and Receive's list). On Receive, click a row's name to open/close it; on Send's left list, click the + / -.
- Project Xfer > Send: Package Name starts with "[type new name here]", then the names you've used. The second dropdown is now Version: "New version" or an earlier package for that name.
- A status line says what you're doing: New / Viewing an earlier version (Package buttons greyed out until something changes) / Changed since <date> (saves a NEW version, the old one stays) / Modifying <date>.
- Modify (next to Clear all): packaging OVERWRITES the version you loaded, e.g. if you forgot something. Its Google Drive copy is replaced too, only if it's already on Drive.
- Package list now has Sent and Version columns. Click a Version to change it. Red = a newer version exists, green = changed since sent. Rows you removed stay greyed out as "removed" (+ puts them back). "Update all to latest" bumps everything.
- Every workspace is listed now, not just Maya: Nuke (.nk), After Effects (.aep), Photoshop (.psd), Houdini (.hip/.hipnc/.hiplc), Blender (.blend). Files named <shot>_<task>.v###.<ext> get versions; any other file can still be ticked and sent on its own. New App column with a filter (click its header). Non-Maya files go as the file only (no footage/caches).
- Receive: Package... now picks the package's folder (e.g. io/xfer/James), and a Version dropdown picks the date (newest by default). Google Drive... lists package folders the same way. The From line shows who sent it, from which computer, and when.
- Receive list: each asset/shot opens to its scenes with Task, App, Version, User (who saved it), Here (the newest you already have) and what will happen.
